t: Add minimal context wakeup mode — skip Skills and lugs loading when switching between spokes quickly
perceive: 1. Read templates/commands/wai.md Steps 1-7 — full wakeup loads State, Skills, Lugs, teachings, tracks. 2. Read templates/commands/wai-closeout.md Step 5 — where _session_state is updated. 3. Estimate token cost of full vs minimal wakeup.
execute: 1. Add _next_session_context_preference field to WAI-State.json _session_state: {minimal: boolean, reason: string}. 2. Add closeout option: at Step 5, if user indicates cross-project switch, set minimal: true with reason. 3. Modify wai.md Step 2: after loading WAI-State.json, check _next_session_context_preference.minimal. If true: skip Steps 3 (Skills), 4 (Lugs), 5 (Teachings), 6 (External Tracks). Show 3-line briefing: project identity, last session summary, 'Minimal mode — run /wai-full for complete context.' 4. Create /wai-full command (templates/commands/wai-full.md): loads Skills, Lugs, and teachings on demand within the session. 5. Clear the minimal flag after one session (reset to false at next closeout). 6. Sync all modified files.
verify: 1. Set minimal: true in WAI-State.json, run wakeup — only State loaded, 3-line briefing. 2. Run /wai-full — Skills and Lugs load on demand. 3. Normal wakeup (minimal: false) — full briefing unchanged. 4. After one session, flag auto-resets.

_behavior_directive.what_this_is: Minimal wakeup mode for fast cross-project switching — skip heavy context, load on demand
_behavior_directive.what_this_is_NOT: Not permanently reducing wakeup — the flag is one-shot, resets after one session
